purpose: Generalize the existing Customer Success capability as the portfolio-wide post-delivery owner from delivered_engagement_v1 through acceptance/support, measured success, retention, renewal/expansion and evidence-permitted proof feedback.

permissions.rule: No customer quote, logo, identity, testimonial, referral request or case-study material may be used externally unless the corresponding permission is GRANTED with evidence.

successOutcomeRules.measuredOutcome: Must be evidence-backed or explicitly marked NOT_MEASURED; never inferred or fabricated.
successOutcomeRules.satisfaction: May be recorded only from authoritative customer evidence or a clearly labeled internal observation.
successOutcomeRules.publicProof: Growth/Proof eligibility requires applicable explicit permission and evidence references; otherwise analytics may receive only non-public/internal outcome data.

renewalExpansionRules.rule: Customer Success may identify and internally hand off an opportunity; Commercial Conversion owns scope, price, proposal and commercial commitment.

rules: delivered_engagement_v1 must contain exact delivery identity and a recorded delivery receipt before Customer Success accepts ownership.
Customer Success acceptance changes lifecycle ownership only; it grants no communication, refund, commercial or publishing authority.
No response from a customer is not acceptance, satisfaction, churn, testimonial permission or renewal intent.
Clarifications remain within Customer Success when no artifact change is required.
Corrections and in-scope revisions requiring artifact changes route to Fulfillment through fulfillment_remediation_request_v1 and preserve original delivery/version history.
New scope requests route to Commercial Conversion through renewal_or_expansion_opportunity_v1; Customer Success does not quote or commit scope/price.
Refund requests and material complaints are classified and escalated; Customer Success cannot approve or execute refunds.
Open complaints, refund requests or unresolved blocking defects suppress proactive upsell/referral/testimonial activity.
Success outcomes must separate measured facts, customer statements, internal interpretations and unknowns.
Customer claims, logos, testimonials and case-study details require explicit permission evidence before Growth/Proof use.
Churn requires explicit termination/non-renewal evidence or an authoritative lifecycle rule; silence alone cannot set CHURNED.
Unknown external outcomes fail closed and are never blindly retried.
P4 validation is simulation-only; externalActionsPerformed and moneyMovementPerformed remain zero.
